execution.execution_mode: Windows runtime using a clean task-specific snapshot extracted from origin/main because full Windows checkout of origin/main is blocked by an existing repository path containing ':'

frozen_task: Recover mission, active block, and exactly one canonical next action from STATE + BLOCKS + MAP + PROOF without reading BATON.json or conversation history.
unit_definition: One field reconstruction = one canonical field resolved into the frozen task result. This is an instrumented engineering unit, not a model-token equivalent.

avoided_work.basis: Cycle A performed four field reconstructions; Cycle B reused three provenance-bound values whose source hashes remained unchanged.
avoided_work.applicability: Same frozen task and same canonical source snapshot; next_action remains mutable and is independently recomputed.

resources.duplicate_reasoning: instrumented as field units; semantic duplicate reasoning is not claimed

interpretation: The run directly observed three avoided field-reconstruction units under the defined engineering unit. This is a bounded computation-saving measurement, not a claim of model-token, GPU, dollar, or semantic-reasoning savings.
evidence_boundary: Model/token work, semantic duplicate reasoning, and human time remain unmeasured; they are explicitly not claimed.
continuation: Calculate defensible avoided computation only where the counterfactual and applicability are evidenced.
